 Black Friday has come earlier than ever this year. We have great options if you're shopping for outdoor gear , kitchen upgrades , and the best toys of the year. Black Friday creeping earlier and earlier isn't such a bad thing. That simply gives us shoppers more time to find the perfect gift at the best price.
 Samsung's lineup of TVs, gaming monitors, phones, and internal storage are all seeing nice discounts. Shopping these early deals means you'll be in great shape for streaming new fall shows, playing upcoming game releases, and keeping family entertained during their holiday visits.

 Why we like it
 Since winter is hibernation season, it's important to go in with plenty of entertainment options. You have your streaming services all set up and gaming options on hand, but if your TV isn't up to the task, the entertainment can suffer. Before the holidays begin, upgrade to the 65-inch Samsung Class S85H Series OLED 4K TV . The OLED display is perfect for clarity and crisp images, whether that's Christmas movies or playing the new GTA 6 .

 Why we like it
 There's a whole lot to like about the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra. Features include a built-in privacy display that automatically hides your screen from nearby people, Galaxy AI features that help with photo editing, and Nightography, which is designed to improve photos and videos taken in low light. There's also a wider front camera for group selfies, an upgraded processor, and support for faster charging.
